## Red at merge

Checks on a pull request's final head that were red, unable to start, cancelled or not yet finished when it merged. GitHub keeps only the latest attempt of a check, so the state describes that attempt: `late` means it finished after the merge time (a slow check or a later re-run; the column after it gives the conclusion), `pending` means it had not finished when the snapshot was read. `no-steps` means a check concluded success with zero executed steps (a hollow pass). `cannot-start` means the check's job executed zero steps; it is startup noise, recorded with its run id, and is not a failing test. A step count of `not observed` means its steps were not read (an external check, or a check that had not finished).
